reason: The hypothesis relies on Hf suppressing precipitates via entropy stabilization, but the cited evidence only shows that a different Hf-containing alloy (W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8) lacked precipitates at 10 dpa (E4) and that HEAs can improve radiation tolerance (E2). No evidence directly supports that adding Hf to W38Ta36Cr15V11 stabilizes the solid solution, suppresses Cr-V precipitates, or preserves manufacturability; the mechanism is assumed rather than demonstrated.
premises: Hf addition stabilizes the solid solution in W38Ta36Cr15V11
Stabilization suppresses Cr-V-rich precipitates at 8 dpa
Configurational entropy of mixing is the operative mechanism
The modified alloy retains low hardening and radiation resistance
Bulk manufacturability is preserved despite Hf addition
